🎥🎬: Stepfather (2026)

Darnell, played by Taye Diggs, meets Asia and quickly becomes part of her family, presenting himself as the perfect husband and stepfather. But beneath his charming exterior is a disturbing pattern: he has repeatedly abandoned the idea of a “perfect family” when things don’t go according to his expectations. 

As Asia and her daughters begin noticing unsettling behavior, they realize Darnell is hiding a dangerous side. His carefully constructed family life starts falling apart as his secrets come to light, forcing them to figure out how to get away from him before he can carry out his plans.
